title: SolveSpace NG review 3: proposed simple improvements
brief: Small changes, each with a test, none touching the file format. Yes, no or later, and a note if you want it different. Old names stay searchable in the palette.

sheets.label: P1 export submenu
sheets.question: P1. File: put the seven Export items under one 'Export' submenu (as Fusion, Onshape, FreeCAD).

sheets.label: P2 preferences
sheets.question: P2. Rename Edit > Configuration... to 'Preferences...' (Fusion, FreeCAD, Blender) and move View Projection... to the View menu.

sheets.label: P3 view panels
sheets.question: P3. View menu: a Panels group with Outliner (O), Properties (N), Problems (Shift+P), Tool Shelf (renamed from Show Toolbar) and Toggle Theme; 'Show Property Browser' becomes 'Classic Property Browser'.

sheets.label: P4 standard views
sheets.question: P4. View menu: a Standard Views submenu (Front 1, Back, Right 3, Left, Top 7, Bottom, Isometric) showing the numpad keys.

sheets.label: P5 names
sheets.question: P5. Consistent names and capitals: 2D/3D ('Sketch in 3D', 'Export 2D View'), and short tool names (Arc, Spline, Text). The long names stay in the palette.

sheets.label: P6 menu keys
sheets.question: P6. Show the Modern key next to a menu item whenever a key does the same thing (D on Distance / Diameter).

sheets.label: P7 outliner icons
sheets.question: P7. Outliner: the shelf's icon for each group's type (sketch, extrude, lathe...), and the status as '4 DOF' (degrees of freedom left) rather than a bare 4.

sheets.label: P8 values
sheets.question: P8. Properties: dimension values at the display precision with units (16.49 mm; still takes an expression), units on lengths, no duplicate rows.

sheets.label: P9 labels
sheets.question: P9. Properties: plain labels (from / to, length, group) instead of the old browser's (thru, len, from request r005-...).

sheets.label: P10 style names
sheets.question: P10. Styles: readable names for the built-in styles (Active group lines, Construction, Points, Constraints, Selected, Hovered...).

sheets.label: P11 prefs order
sheets.question: P11. Preferences: the NG section (theme, keys) first rather than last.

sheets.label: P12 pie icons
sheets.question: P12. Pies: the shelf icons beside each item, as Blender's pies show.

sheets.label: P13 context menu
sheets.question: P13. Right-click menu: 'Group Properties' / 'Style Properties' instead of Group Info / Style Info, and add Grab (G), Dimension (D), Constrain... (F), Hide Group (H).

sheets.label: P14 problems names
sheets.question: P14. Problems: name the culprits as 'Vertical (c003)' with their icon, and the group by its name only.
